description: Compare 1 to 3 offers on the same billing term and period. prices maps offer_id to the monthly price the buyer would pay for that product without the offer (same currency as the vendor). Returns fit and cost per offer: pay today, cost over the period with and without the offer, saving, or why it cannot be calculated (credits, a longer trial, unknown duration).

billing.description: Billing term to compare on: 'monthly', 'annual' or 'biennial'.
billing.title: Billing

months.description: Period to compare over, in months (default 12).
months.title: Months

offer_ids.description: 1 to 3 offer ids, each from the id field of a search_offers result.
offer_ids.title: Offer Ids

prices.description: The monthly price the buyer would pay without the offer, as {offer_id: amount}, in the vendor's currency.
prices.title: Prices

situation.description: Same as check_offer_eligibility: {customer, plan, billing}; optional.
situation.title: Situation

name: compare_offer_costs
